reviews.text:
If you're looking for a veterinarian to whom you can confidently entrust the health of your pet, Dr. D'Isa is undoubtedly the best choice you can make.
​What immediately stands out is his extraordinary professionalism: combined with impeccable training and a consistently meticulous approach, he conveys profound reassurance even in the most delicate moments. But what truly makes the difference is his immense passion for veterinary medicine. It's not just a job, but a true vocation: he genuinely loves animals, treats them with unique kindness and respect, and manages to put even the most frightened patients at ease.
​Another key aspect is his availability: always present, empathetic, and ready to listen and clarify any doubts with patience and clarity, without ever making the owner feel abandoned or rushed.
​I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. D'Isa to anyone seeking excellent care, respect, and a deep sense of humanity for their four-legged companion. Don't have any doubts: go to him and you will see the difference!

If you're looking for a doctor, he's the one, Dr. D'Isa Mariano. I have two dogs, a 62 kg mixed breed and a German Shepherd, and I couldn't be happier to have met this doctor 11 years ago. He has demonstrated extraordinary professionalism and a deep knowledge of animal pathologies. He explains every diagnosis and treatment clearly, reassuringly, and without any rush. He is always available and friendly. I highly recommend this practice to anyone looking for a reliable reference for their pet.

If I could, I'd give more stars. The doctor is super helpful, punctual, ready to help (which isn't a given), and above all, AVAILABLE, which isn't a given.
He saved my guinea pig, I wouldn't trade him for anything in the world, and I've already recommended him to several friends. What a wonderful discovery!

My wife and I took a few-month-old kitten to Dr. Mariano Disa, and we couldn't have made a better choice. He's an extraordinary young professional who knows his job very well, demonstrating a rare gift: empathy and the ability to relate perfectly to both animals and their owners.
The visit was impeccable: rigorous, scientific, and meticulous from start to finish. He demonstrated the utmost professionalism, both in his approach to the kitten and in the precision of his prescriptions and medical advice.
Finally, a skilled veterinarian in Naples who works with passion and honesty, without charging exorbitant prices or being overpriced, as unfortunately often happens. Highly recommended!

Congratulations, I'm really happy to have found everything in one place: the professional, Dr. D'Isa, is commendable, kind, courteous, sweet, helpful, and honest. My Marty was very calm, he had his visit without a complaint, I highly recommend Dr. D'Isa to everyone, acquaintances or not, who need a check-up for their furry friends. Yesterday I hit the jackpot in every sense, the service is not to be underestimated, he showed me how to get to the office and even where to park, all with precise and clear messages. Satisfied, I repeat, convinced, and I will definitely bring my furry friends when I need them. If I could, I would have given 10💯💯💯🍀💪

I took my dog ​​to Dr. D'Isa for the first time on the recommendation of a dear friend, and I immediately knew we'd found the right person. Attentive, kind, super professional, and honest. I recommend him myself.

After visiting many vets, Dr. Mariano D'Isa was recommended to me.
At Noah's first visit, my daughter and I were pleasantly impressed by the doctor's professionalism.
All subsequent visits have always been attentive and thorough, with precise diagnoses and appropriate treatments. He was the only one who was able to treat my dog's dermatitis with great results.
The doctor is empathetic, kind, answers all questions, is available, and above all, calms you down in stressful situations.
He has become our trusted vet, and I highly recommend him to everyone!
The office is new, well-maintained, and extremely clean, easily accessible on Viale Augusto in Fuorigrotta.

Even though I've only known him for a few months, Dr. Mariano d'Isa immediately impressed me with his expertise, professionalism, and helpfulness.
He identified and understood my dog's problem, even though it was a fairly complex condition, prescribing specific tests and a personalized diet.
He's very knowledgeable (he's a multi-specialty veterinarian).
He always answers phone messages and doesn't make you feel worried about your pet.
And last but not least, he's not at all greedy.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

A truly positive experience (and that's an understatement). The doctor greeted us with kindness and courtesy. It goes without saying that our puppy's visit was handled with a truly professional approach. We know who to trust from now on!

Dr. Mariano D'Isa has been treating my dog ​​for 15 years now, and my other dog for three years as well. He's extremely professional and always available. Every diagnosis my dogs have received has always been accurate, followed by targeted treatment that has only brought benefits. He literally saved my 15-year-old dog twice with early diagnoses and extremely effective treatments, despite his age and various ailments.

Finally, he's honest and not at all greedy.

I highly recommend him.
I can only thank Dr. D'Isa for his patience, dedication, professionalism and sensitivity 🙏 …

The emergency room was a success, thanks to his availability, helpfulness, and professionalism.
Qualities that all veterinarians should have.
Dr. D'Isa Mariano has them all.
Thank you.

An exemplary professional: Dr. D'Isa is always available, prompt, polite, and above all, very knowledgeable and confident.
The office is welcoming and conveniently located.
Highly recommended.

Doctor Mariano D'isa is professional, serious and not venal. He has been taking care of my rabbit Giulio for almost nine years and I must say that he practices his profession with heart. Very good and helpful, punctual in appointments. His office is very well kept with maximum hygiene. What can I say? He is an impeccable veterinary doctor, he saved my little rabbit twice. GOD BLESS HIM.

I want to sincerely thank Dr. D'Isa for his professionalism. My dog ​​underwent surgery for mammary cancer with complete removal of the right mammary gland. The surgery and post-op went very well. My dog ​​recovered quickly and was treated with great care and attention. Highly recommended vet!

Dr. Mariano D'Isa has been treating my dog ​​for six years now, and I must say that his professionalism, empathy, kindness, and above all his great availability, even over the phone, to address my concerns, is priceless. In fact, even in this regard, the doctor is not at all greedy.
The veterinary practice is new, spacious, and impeccably clean. Appointment times are always respected, and the doctor, with years of experience, does it not just for the profession, but for the great love he has for animals.
I would definitely recommend "Pet Vet Center" to anyone who cares about the health and care of their furry friends. The practice is located in Fuorigrotta at Viale Augusto, 79.
Seeing is believing!

Dr. D'Isa has been treating my Dafne for six years now. Always available (at any time), honest, knowledgeable, professional, ready to immediately understand the problem and resolve it quickly, very patient and polite.
What can I say? He does his job with love and passion.
The best.
Thank you, doctor.
Excellent professional, always available, prepared, attentive and loving towards our furry friends.. a certainty💪🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 …
Competent and helpful doctor, recommended.

Well, what can I say? In addition to his undeniable professionalism, Dr. Mariano D'isa is endowed with immense empathy and availability... Scrupulous, patient, sweet and always present at all times... He has been following my furry friend for eight years, saving her life when she was a puppy and, while others told me that there was nothing that could be done, Dr. Mariano persevered without ever giving up... Highly recommended.

Since we met Dr. D'Isa, our dog has always received impeccable, excellent care. Dr. D'Isa is a true professional, courteous, well-mannered, and always attentive to his patients' needs. We couldn't have asked for more!

I've known the doctor for over 20 years and have complete trust in him. He's empathetic, knowledgeable, and gentle with his patients, and patient with us anxious moms. He's always available for comfort or advice. In short, if you have a small pet and want peace of mind, Mariano D'Isa is the perfect person for you!

Education, professionalism, and extreme availability.

My puppy was entrusted to him from day one.

The doctor is simply perfect. He takes care of all my animals, and I always end up going to him. These days, it's hard to find a doctor this thorough and who responds quickly (he understands our concerns). I'm sure I'll always choose him for my other future pets. ❤️
Mariano D'Isa, an excellent vet, has been treating my little Joele for 5 years. Thank you, Mariano.
The best doctor I have found and I am currently very happy with him.
It's a beautiful, spacious office. Dr. Mariano is an exceptional person. Professional, humble, kind, and above all, extremely knowledgeable.
